checks.label: Subject-isolated development roles
checks.evidence: 187 subjects are assigned by subject role.
checks.next_action: Preserve subject and session grouping in every new adapter.

checks.label: Nested controller selection
checks.evidence: Fusion/calibration and operating-point selection use separate controller subroles.
checks.next_action: Keep all fusion, calibration, and threshold choices outside observed test subjects.

checks.label: Full-montage QC before reference
checks.next_action: Continue reporting exclusions and sensitivity to QC thresholds.

checks.label: Existing synchronized EMG source
checks.evidence: OpenBMI loader recognizes four EMG channels, but v3 stores only aggregate auxiliary quality.
checks.next_action: Retain EMG waveforms and derive silence, onset, RMS, and waveform-length labels.

checks.label: External multimodal teacher catalog
checks.evidence: 7 EEG-EMG sources are cataloged with modality-specific roles.
checks.next_action: Implement the MRCP EEG-EMG adapter first; do not pool execution labels with imagery.

checks.label: Modality-specific auxiliary processing
checks.evidence: EMG and EOG are currently merged into generic auxiliary peak-to-peak/RMS features.
checks.next_action: Split EMG, EOG, and device channels before feature extraction and gating.

checks.label: Robustly scaled quality gate
checks.evidence: The current heterogeneous-distance threshold is 301,511.3, indicating scale domination.
checks.next_action: Fit median/IQR scaling per feature and report per-domain rejection rates.

checks.label: Causal deployable preprocessing
checks.evidence: Final reported profile uses phase=zero filtering.
checks.next_action: Re-run the locked candidate with causal filters and measure added latency/performance loss.

checks.label: Continuous no-control safety
checks.evidence: Not evaluated: no hard-negative manifest was supplied. Cue-locked window specificity is not converted into a deployment false-activation rate.
checks.next_action: Add continuous idle, gaze, speech, jaw, posture, and device-motion hard negatives.

checks.label: Locked external confirmation
checks.next_action: Freeze v4, then evaluate once on untouched subjects/sessions.

multimodal_datasets.name: MRCP Hand Gesture EEG-EMG Dataset
multimodal_datasets.recommended_role: First multimodal adapter: MRCP pretraining, EMG-onset labels, and session-drift validation
multimodal_datasets.integration_status: CSV synchronization and event adapter required
multimodal_datasets.caveat: Execution-only and right-hand-only; use EMG as timing supervision, not as proof of EEG imagery decoding.
multimodal_datasets.movement_ground_truth: Synchronized forearm EMG and visual-interface event triggers

multimodal_datasets.name: WAY-EEG-GAL Grasp-and-Lift
multimodal_datasets.rest_support: Return-to-rest phase and 16 behaviorally defined event times
multimodal_datasets.recommended_role: Multimodal onset teacher and force/kinematic validation with explicit modality ablation
multimodal_datasets.caveat: Overt right-hand execution in 12 participants; recent LOSO work found weight/surface decoding predominantly EMG-driven.
multimodal_datasets.movement_ground_truth: EMG, hand/object kinematics, force, and 16 trial event timestamps

multimodal_datasets.name: NeBULA Standardized Reaching EEG-EMG
multimodal_datasets.recommended_role: Human-robot artifact, assistance-domain shift, and compensation robustness benchmark
multimodal_datasets.integration_status: BIDS EEG/EMG adapter required; large download
multimodal_datasets.caveat: Overt right-arm reaching with only 10 repetitions per condition; do not pool its labels with hand imagery.
multimodal_datasets.movement_ground_truth: GO/reach markers, upper-limb EMG, and exoskeleton endpoint/joint telemetry

multimodal_datasets.name: EEG-EMG WristMotion Pointing
multimodal_datasets.rest_support: Pre/post baseline and synchronized trial timestamps
multimodal_datasets.recommended_role: Direction, latency, and continuous kinematic-teacher benchmark
multimodal_datasets.caveat: Overt wrist movement in healthy participants; the eight-channel montage limits direct spatial transfer.
multimodal_datasets.movement_ground_truth: Synchronized EMG, robotic encoders, event markers, and trajectory metrics

multimodal_datasets.name: High-density EEG-EMG Object Prehension
multimodal_datasets.sessions: 3 grip types; dynamic and holding phases
multimodal_datasets.rest_support: Visual GO and sensorized-object phase markers
multimodal_datasets.caveat: Small overt-movement cohort; useful for physiological features, not cross-subject imagery claims.
multimodal_datasets.movement_ground_truth: Thirteen-muscle EMG plus object contact and lift-completion sensing

multimodal_datasets.name: Severe Stroke Attempted-Movement EEG-EMG Cohort
multimodal_datasets.rest_support: Randomized 4-5 second rest, 4 second attempt, and 8-9 second inter-trial intervals
multimodal_datasets.license: Article open access; participant data access not confirmed
multimodal_datasets.recommended_role: Clinical protocol template and potential author-request external validation cohort
multimodal_datasets.integration_status: Contact authors or locate repository before implementation
multimodal_datasets.caveat: Do not assume the participant-level recordings are downloadable; published results are within-patient block validation.
multimodal_datasets.movement_ground_truth: Attempt cue plus bilateral task-related and compensatory-muscle EMG

multimodal_datasets.name: OpenBMI Motor Imagery
multimodal_datasets.rest_support: Resting-state recording and within-trial baseline intervals
multimodal_datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 data article; toolbox GPL-3.0
multimodal_datasets.integration_status: Local NEMAR BIDS adapter and raw-window cache builder available
